Elaine: Heads-up — the 'Latency Economics' blog is scheduled to publish Wed 10:00am PT. Quick question: do we allow partners to syndicate immediately or hold syndication for a short window? Also need Legal sign-off on the quote.
Samir: @Elaine i'd prefer partners can syndicate right away, but hold broader press outreach for 24h so we can capture initial metrics. Any legal concerns?
Kai: @Samir @Elaine Legal note: syndicating short excerpts is fine. Any definitive performance claims need CTO sign-off. Send me the final quote today and I can approve or flag it.
Morgan: I can craft partner syndication copy + a LinkedIn/Twitter variant. If we hold outreach 24h i’ll also prep an FAQ doc. Drafts here: https://drive.redwood/latency-draft (preview).
Elaine: Partners asked if we can do 9:00am ET syndication. Our current publish is 10:00am PT (which is 1:00pm ET) — that's not aligned. Ops can't do 6:00am PT days.
Samir: Options: (A) shift publish to 9:00am ET / 6:00am PT (yikes for Ops) or (B) keep publish at 10:00am PT and syndicate partners at 1:00pm ET. Which wins?
Elaine: Ops can't staff 6am PT. Let's stick to 10:00am PT publish and offer partners a 1:00pm ET syndication. That keeps internal folks sane.
PressBot: Note: Partner 'TechToday' requested a 24h exclusive starting at syndication time. If we give them 1:00pm ET syndication, their exclusivity runs until 1:00pm ET tomorrow.
Samir: TechToday confirmed 1:00pm ET is fine. Action items: Kai — sign off quote by EOD. Elaine — confirm final publish time. Morgan — prep syndication copy + FAQ and send preview to partners. I'll send TechToday the preview once quote approved.
Kai: I'll review the quote now. If I don't leave a comment by 6:00pm PT, consider it approved.
Elaine: Final plan: Publish 10:00am PT (1:00pm ET), partners syndicate at 1:00pm ET, broader press outreach starts at 1:00pm ET, hold paid promos for 24h. I'll post final timeline in #launch-day tomorrow morning. :party-parrot:
